The remaining Trainer target paths, including POW! Hand Extension and the effect consumers that are not switch effects, retain separate review. Batch 73 corrects POW! Hustle Play discounts only Colorless symbols, including on inherited attacks. Live controls for Mew ex 30C Memory Helix and Mew ex MEW Genome Hacking pass. These card paths report conditions through the resolved attack, including on copied attacks, and continue to use power-origin effects for actual Abilities. Batch 37 extends that route to 397 classic status attacks. Source review corrected printed attacks on the two Noble Victories Cryogonal prints, Secret Wonders Bulbasaur and Undaunted Leafeon. It also removes erroneous Confusion from Data Retrieval and confines that bonus to Scramble Trip. The tracked queue drops from 306 to 137 remaining sites. This partial port preserves the fork’s attack pipeline. Batch 39 verifies six switch-then-status attacks, Poison Rub’s pre-damage switch, and delayed Knock Outs. Typed protection now checks the selected Bench slot and the actual source of delayed effects. This resolves 14 more call sites. The remaining queue has 123 sites across 112 card definitions. Batch 40 verifies 72 more attacks and resolves 81 sites. Optional Energy costs now use the Energy each card actually provides and require successful discard, including Prism Star routing. Ice Bind and Leaf Hurricane resolve after damage. The tracked queue contains 42 calls in 41 definitions. Batch 41 corrects the five printed Black & White definitions, Clefairy RCL and Break Beam, and resolves seven tracked calls. The queue has 35 calls in 34 definitions. Batch 42 moves Needle Shock to player turn history, restores the printed Smogscreen and Octazooka lifecycles, fixes the Chaos Rising Octillery aliases and corrects the three Sword & Shield legacy collector numbers. Eight tracked calls are resolved. The queue has 27 calls in 27 definitions. Batch 43 checks the corresponding physical prints, migrates the 27 remaining Special Condition calls to attack provenance and completes this queue. Energy Antics and Graffiti honor the protected source, destination and defender rulings. Other upstream paths continue under their own review records. Batch 99 ports the modern damage/effect shields on Cynthia’s Feebas DRI, Barboach OBF, Hoppip PAL, Charcadet PAR, Seaking MEW, Flittle SSP, Dunsparce TEF and Marill ASC. Dig uses the printed attack and Gnaw never flips. Shelmet JTG and Altaria SSP prevent damage only. Noivern ex PAL, Nidoqueen MEW, Dipplin SCR, Golbat CRI and Mega Manectric ex MEG only prevent damage from Basic Pokémon. Shred bypasses these damage shields, old snapshot markers keep working, and Roaring Moon ex PAR only takes Frenzied Gouging recoil when the defending Pokémon was Knocked Out (a1e541bca). Cherubi 30C already passes the same controls. Joltik SFA, Eiscue ex OBF, Iron Bundle PAR, N’s Vanillish ASC and Mabosstiff PBL are still open for this pass. Batch 100 completes the review of the 21 modern card paths in this refactor. It corrects Joltik SFA’s full shield, Eiscue ex OBF’s post-damage Energy discard and target lock, N’s Vanillish ASC and Iron Bundle PAR’s target-owned locks, and Mabosstiff PBL’s once-only post-Weakness damage bonus. The shared lock also fixes Masquerain DLR. The existing legacy paths retain their separate historical review status.
